mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_account ( settlement_id, linked_account_id, account_status, selected_at, ended_at ) VALUES ( #{settlementId}, #{linkedAccountId}, #{accountStatus}, #{selectedAt}, #{endedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT settlement_account_id, settlement_id, linked_account_id, account_status, selected_at, ended_at FROM settlement_account WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ended_at IS NULL

SELECT settlement_account_id, settlement_id, linked_account_id, account_status, selected_at, ended_at FROM settlement_account WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_account SET account_status = #{accountStatus}, ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE settlement_account_id = #{settlementAccountId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'
